d:
Congress has shared excerpts from Sonia Gandhi's upcoming memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love, in which she recalls the assassination of her mother-in-law, former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi, on October 31, 1984. In an extract published by The Guardian, Sonia describes seeing Indira's bloodied body, rushing her to hospital and pleading with Rajiv Gandhi not to become Prime Minister. She also recalls the moment Rajiv was sworn in later that evening.
